title: Double Bubble
description: Draw two white circles on a black background that overlap and merge into one shape. Both have radius 0.4. One is centered at (-0.3, 0.0) and the other at (0.3, 0.0). The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: Each circle has its own distance, length(uv - center) - radius. To keep whichever shape is nearer, take min() of the two distances.
